title: Translate and beat · Level 2: Triangle, hexagon, star
brief: The class robot starts in the middle of a 2400 x 2400 mm floor facing +x (starts vary 10 mm and 2 degrees); the level fixes the robot. In this order, from one function polygon(n, side) (the star as star(points, side), or polygon with a turn argument): an equilateral triangle of 500 mm sides, a regular hexagon of 250 mm sides and a five-point star of 400 mm lines, standing still for 1 s between shapes (wait(1000)): the course splits the trail at the first two stops, and each shape's closing error (its distance plus 2 mm per degree) runs from where it began to where the next stop begins (the star's, to the run's end); the worst of the three is the run's. Fewer than two stops: not every side drawn. The run ends when the program ends, or at 90 s. Line budget: 20 non-blank lines. 50 points for a closing error under 30 mm, plus 40 x min(1, 5 mm / error), plus 10 at or under par time with the program within the line budget. A run that does not draw every side (the axle's middle travels 90 % of the perimeters and each shape encloses 80 % of its area) scores 0. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them closing within 30 mm (every side drawn). Par: 40 s.

score.run: if(trailLength >= 0.9 * perim & pieceArea_1 >= 0.8 * area1 & pieceArea_2 >= 0.8 * area2 & pieceArea_3 >= 0.8 * area3, let e = max(max((pieceClose_1 + headW * pieceTurn_1), (pieceClose_2 + headW * pieceTurn_2)), (pieceClose_3 + headW * pieceTurn_3)) in round(if(e < closeMm, 50, 0) + if(e <= precMm, 40, 40 * precMm / e) + if(time <= par & programLines <= lineBudget, 10, 0), 1), 0)

closes.value: count(r in runs: r.trailLength >= 0.9 * perim & r.pieceArea_1 >= 0.8 * area1 & r.pieceArea_2 >= 0.8 * area2 & r.pieceArea_3 >= 0.8 * area3 & max(max((r.pieceClose_1 + headW * r.pieceTurn_1), (r.pieceClose_2 + headW * r.pieceTurn_2)), (r.pieceClose_3 + headW * r.pieceTurn_3)) <= closeMm)

G4.1 Shape artist: every side drawn (90 % of the perimeter, 80 % of the area by the shoelace formula), a stop (still 0.9 s after first moving: 5 deg/s, 3 mm/s)
